# DateBlock

A calendar date reduced to a month abbreviation over a day figure, used as a row's leading mark.

## Anatomy

A fixed-width column: the month in the mono label face, the day in the display face beneath it, closed by a hairline rule on the right.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `month` *(required)* | `string` | — | Abbreviated month, already localised by the caller. |
| `day` *(required)* | `string \| number` | — | — |
| `label` | `string` | — | The full date, announced in place of the two fragments. Without it a screen reader hears "MAR 14" as two unrelated strings; the reference has no such affordance. |

## Variants

None.

## States

Static only.

## Keyboard

Not interactive.

## ARIA

Given `label`, the block becomes a single `img` with the full date as its name and its two fragments hidden — without it a screen reader hears "MAR" and "14" as unrelated strings.

## Accessibility acceptance criteria

- Reachable, operable and leavable by keyboard alone, with a focus indicator meeting 3:1 in both schemes.
- An accessible name for every control, and current state exposed programmatically.
- No meaning carried by colour alone.
- Legible and operable at a 360px viewport and at desktop width, and at 200% zoom.
- Interactive targets at least 44 × 44px on touch-capable viewports.
